overview_description.description: SOMOS is a platform that helps mission-driven professionals, social impact leaders, equity professionals, founders, and consultants build flexible, independent careers. It provides tools for selling services, managing clients, and tracking revenue without recruitment fees or commissions. The platform includes positioning support, pricing tools, editorial planning, invoicing, and strategy resources. SOMOS also offers ownership tokens, allowing contributors to earn a stake in the platform.
